add-text-field-to-pdf.title: Add Text Field to PDF Using FormEditor
add-text-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a single‑line text field at specific coordinates to an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf's FormEditor.

fill-textbox-field-in-pdf.title: Fill TextBox Form Field in PDF using Aspose.Pdf
fill-textbox-field-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, fill a textbox AcroForm field with a string value using the Form facade, and save the updated document.

justify-text-in-pdf-form-textbox.title: Justify Text in PDF Form TextBox
justify-text-in-pdf-form-textbox.description: Demonstrates how to set a textbox form field's visual alignment to justified using FormEditor, then fill the field with text and save the updated PDF.

retrieve-radio-button-option-values.title: Retrieve Radio Button Group Options and Store in Hashtable
retrieve-radio-button-option-values.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, extracting all option values of a radio button group using Form.GetButtonOptionValues, and placing them into a Hashtable for quick index lookup.

get-selected-radio-button-value.title: Get Selected Radio Button Value from PDF Form
get-selected-radio-button-value.description: Shows how to bind a PDF document, retrieve the currently selected option of a radio button group using Form.GetButtonOptionCurrentValue, and properly dispose the Form object.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-xfdf.title: Export PDF Form Data to XFDF
export-pdf-form-fields-to-xfdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF containing AcroForm fields and export the field values to an XFDF (FDF) file using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form facade.

import-form-fields-from-xml.title: Import Form Field Values from XML into a PDF
import-form-fields-from-xml.description: Shows how to load a PDF with AcroForm fields, read an XML file as a stream, import the field values using the Form facade, and save the resulting filled PDF.

import-fdf-data-into-pdf-form.title: Import FDF Data into a PDF Using Form Facade
import-fdf-data-into-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, import form field values from an FDF file via the Form facade, and save the updated document.

import-json-data-into-pdf-form.title: Import JSON Data into PDF Form
import-json-data-into-pdf-form.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF form, importing field values from a JSON file using Form.ImportJson, and saving the filled PDF with error handling.

batch-import-json-data-into-pdfs.title: Batch Import JSON Data into PDFs in Parallel
batch-import-json-data-into-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to import form data from multiple JSON files into matching PDF templates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, processing the files concurrently with Parallel.ForEach.

combine-acroform-json-exports.title: Combine PDF Exported JSON Files into a Single JSON Array
combine-acroform-json-exports.description: Reads JSON files generated from AcroForm PDFs, validates them as JSON objects, and merges them into one JSON array written to a file.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-memorystream.title: Export AcroForm Data to XML Using MemoryStream
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml-memorystream.description: Shows how to load a PDF, access its AcroForm via the Form facade, and export the form data to an XML string using a MemoryStream, avoiding any intermediate files on disk.

merge-acroform-data-into-json.title: Merge AcroForm Data from Multiple PDFs into JSON
merge-acroform-data-into-json.description: Loads several PDF files, extracts each document's AcroForm field names and values, aggregates the data keyed by file name, and writes the combined result to a formatted JSON file.

export-filter-pdf-form-fields-xfdf.title: Export Customer AcroForm Fields to XML
export-filter-pdf-form-fields-xfdf.description: Loads a PDF, selects only form fields whose names start with "Customer", and writes their names and values into an XML file.

export-selected-acroform-fields-to-json.title: Export Selected AcroForm Fields to JSON
export-selected-acroform-fields-to-json.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, extracting values of specific form fields by name, and writing those values to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-xml-import-into-pdf-form.title: Validate XML against XSD and Import into PDF Form
validate-xml-import-into-pdf-form.description: The example validates an XML file using an XSD schema and, when the data is valid, imports it into an AcroForm PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

export-import-pdf-form-fields-utf8.title: Export and Re‑Import Form Data with UTF‑8 Encoding (FDF)
export-import-pdf-form-fields-utf8.description: Demonstrates exporting AcroForm field values to an FDF stream and importing them back, preserving Unicode characters by using UTF‑8 encoding.

list-pdf-form-fields-to-csv.title: Export PDF Form Fields to CSV
list-pdf-form-fields-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF document, iterates through its AcroForm fields using Aspose.Pdf, and writes each field's name and type to a CSV report.

export-text-acroform-field-names-to-json.title: Export Text Form Field Names to JSON
export-text-acroform-field-names-to-json.description: Demonstrates how to use the Aspose.Pdf Facade to retrieve all AcroForm fields, filter only text fields, and write their names to a JSON file.

add-radio-button-group-to-pdf.title: Add Radio Button Group with Default Selection to PDF
add-radio-button-group-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a radio button group with three options in an existing PDF and set the default selected option programmatically using Aspose.Pdf FormEditor.

validate-radio-button-options.title: Verify Radio Button Options in an AcroForm
validate-radio-button-options.description: Loads a PDF, extracts the options of a specified radio button field, and compares them against an expected set to ensure form integrity.

update-pdf-acroform-fields-from-byte-arr.title: Update PDF Form Fields from Byte Array
update-pdf-acroform-fields-from-byte-arr.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, modifies text, checkbox, and radio button AcroForm fields, and returns the updated PDF as a byte array.

extract-pdf-form-field-names.title: Extract PDF Form Field Names to JSON
extract-pdf-form-field-names.description: Shows how to read AcroForm field names from a PDF using the Form facade and output them as indented JSON on the console.

fill-pdf-acroform-fields.title: Fill PDF Form Fields Using Aspose.Pdf
fill-pdf-acroform-fields.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, populate its AcroForm fields from a dictionary, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

import-json-data-into-pdf-acroform.title: Import JSON Data into PDF Form Using Aspose.Pdf Facade
import-json-data-into-pdf-acroform.description: Shows how to serialize a C# object to JSON, place it in a memory stream, and import the data into an AcroForm PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json-chunks.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON and Split into Chunks
export-pdf-form-data-to-json-chunks.description: Shows how to export AcroForm fields from a PDF to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf and then split the JSON into multiple files, each containing up to 100 fields.

export-pdf-form-to-xml-html.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML and Convert to HTML with XSLT
export-pdf-form-to-xml-html.description: Demonstrates exporting AcroForm fields from a PDF to Xfdf (XML) using the Form facade and then transforming the XML to an HTML view with XSLT.

import-xml-into-pdf-form-validate-requir.title: Import XML Data into PDF Form and Validate Required Fields
import-xml-into-pdf-form-validate-requir.description: Demonstrates loading XML into a DataTable, filling an AcroForm using AutoFiller, and checking that required fields are not empty.

async-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.title: Async Export PDF Form Data to XML (JSON)
async-export-pdf-form-data-to-xml.description: Demonstrates how to use async/await to export form field data from a PDF to a file (named *.xml) using Aspose.Pdf's ExportToJson method without blocking the UI thread.

create-pdf-form-fields-report.title: Generate PDF Report of AcroForm Fields
create-pdf-form-fields-report.description: Loads a PDF, extracts its AcroForm fields, and creates a new PDF containing a table that lists each field's name, type, and value.

list-pdf-form-field-names__v2.title: List PDF Form Field Names using Form Facade
list-pdf-form-field-names__v2.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF with the Form facade and retrieve all AcroForm field names, printing them to the console.

export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v5.title: Export PDF Form Data to XML (FDF)
export-pdf-form-data-to-xml__v5.description: Shows how to load a PDF document, use the Form facade, and export all AcroForm field values to an XML‑based FDF file.

export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf__v2.title: Export PDF Form Data to FDF
export-pdf-form-data-to-fdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF, bind it to the Form facade, and export its AcroForm field values to an FDF file using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v6.title: Export Pdf Form Fields To Json__V6

import-xfdf-data-into-pdf-form__v2.title: Import XFDF Data into PDF Form
import-xfdf-data-into-pdf-form__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF, import form field values from an XFDF file using the Form facade, and save the updated PDF.

import-form-data-from-json__v2.title: Import JSON Form Data into PDF
import-form-data-from-json__v2.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, binding it to the Form facade, importing form field values from a JSON file (ignoring missing fields), and saving the updated document.

fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json__v3.title: Fill PDF Form Fields from JSON Template
fill-pdf-form-fields-from-json__v3.description: Demonstrates loading a JSON file, mapping its key/value pairs to AcroForm field names, and saving the PDF with the fields pre‑filled using Aspose.Pdf.

export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v7.title: Export PDF Form Data to JSON and Deserialize in C#
export-pdf-form-data-to-json__v7.description: Demonstrates exporting AcroForm fields from a PDF to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf and deserializing the JSON into a strongly-typed C# object with Json.NET.

import-json-data-into-pdf-form__v2.title: Import XML Data into PDF Form with Missing Field Error Handling
import-json-data-into-pdf-form__v2.description: Shows how to import form data from an XML file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form and catch FormException to log the name of any missing form field.
